about.bio_1: I'm Dean Michniew — Bingham-born, Bingham-based, and the bloke at the front of the Sunday Run Club every week, rain or shine. Level 3 qualified Personal Trainer and functional-fitness coach.
about.bio_2: I came to coaching after years on the other side of the conversation — desk job, slow drift, then the realisation that being strong and capable changed everything else in my life. Now I do this full time, and I get to watch other people find their own version of that change.
about.bio_3: I still compete. Hyrox, races, lifting events. If I'm asking you to push your limits, I'd better be pushing mine.

items.quote: Going from someone who has never done more than 10 minutes exercise without getting out of breath, to someone who does at least 2hrs of fitness every day is a transformation I could never have dreamed of. Starting small with one group class a week with Dean, then two, then three, then with PT, then two PT, then run club (etc) has been an absolutely magical experience, and Dean has been there supporting and pushing me all the way. He is incredibly receptive to where I was in my fitness journey (ie, nowhere) and grows the plan around you as you change. He has changed my life immeasurably for the better - the new experiences I have done, people I have met, and friendships I have gained are priceless, as is a trust in my body to perform things I could never have dreamed of. If anyone is on the fence about whether a PT is for them, Dean is for you.
items.name: James K.

items.question: Do I need to be fit to start?
items.answer: Absolutely not. I work with every level — from 'haven't exercised in a decade' to 'running my next half'.

items.question: How often should I train?
items.answer: 2–3× a week is the sweet spot for most. I'll work with what your week actually looks like.

items.question: Can I bring a friend?
items.answer: Yes. Small-group sessions (2–3) are available at a reduced per-person rate.

items.question: Do you offer online coaching?
items.answer: No. In-person only — coaching is the bit you're paying for.

contact.blurb: No commitment, no pressure — just a chat about where you're at and the smallest brave step. Reply within 24 hours, usually faster on Instagram.
